newsitem.title: USA: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: U.S. HEADLINE STOCKS - Issues to Watch - Nov 11.

text.p: -- Drug wholesaler Bergen Brunswig Corp will merge with IVAX Corp in a $1.65 billion stock swap that values IVAX at less than its market price.
IVAX holders will get 0.42 share of the new company's stock for each existing share, worth about $13.75. The shares closed on Friday at 15-3/4, off 1/8.
Bergen Brunswig shares closed at 32-3/4, up 3/8.

-- General Motors new three-year labor contract could hold its manufacturing efficiency in 1999 to about halfway where its best rivals are today, the Journal said. GM shares closed at 55-1/2, off 5/8.
-- Loral Space & Communications Ltd is near a pact with China to distribute phone service for its Globalstar Telecommunications Ltd satellite network, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
-- Cytec Industries proposed up to 115 job cuts at its Botlek plant. Shares closed at 34-3/4.
